text: The clarinets are always at their best They chime in with the rest And the dockies dance right through their fumes They all forget some empty blues When ragtime rufus drags the humor ass After hearing opera grand Rendered by a ragtime band I must confess Now I'm thoroughly convinced That there is nothing sweeter Than a single-painted meter
